description: Compare provider-level home internet summaries from docs/data/internet.json. Filter by country, technology, advertised speed, listed monthly price, commitment duration, or provider; sort by price, indicative price per advertised Mbps, or speed. Each result includes the provider's address-availability checker and source links. This source contains summarized ranges, not individual address quotes; unknown values stay null, and availability must be confirmed with the provider.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "CZ". Optional: normally derived from the address.

name: compare_internet
title: Compare home internet providers
